2201.commentary: (DNa) pāṇam'atipātāpayato'ti pāṇaṃ hanantassa'pi hanāpentassa'pi. evaṃ sabbattha karaṇa-kāraṇa-vasen'eva attho veditabbo.

examples.text: karoto kho, mahārāja, kārayato, chindato chedāpayato, pacato pācāpayato socayato, socāpayato, kilamato kilamāpayato, phandato phandāpayato, pāṇam'atipātāpayato… karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ.
attanā ca pāṇa-atipātī hoti parañ'ca pāṇ'ātipāte samādapeti pāṇ'ātipāte ca samanuñño hoti
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, idh'assa puriso pāṇa-atipātī adinn'ādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavāco pharusavāco samphappalāpī abhijjhālu byāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhiko.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evarūpo javo ahosi, seyyathā'pi nāma daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho kat'ūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasirena tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya.
yo pāṇam'atipāteti, musāvādañ'ca bhāsati, loke adinnam'ādiyati, paradārañ'ca gacchati.
addasā kho āyasmā ānando sambahule licchavikumārake santh'āgāre upāsanaṃ karonte, dūrato'va sukhumena tāḷacchiggaḷena asanaṃ atipātente, poṅkh'ānupoṅkhaṃ avirādhitaṃ.

examples.text: yathā'pi bhaddo ājañño, dhure yutto dhurassaho, mathito atibhārena, saṃyugaṃ n'ātivattati.

examples.text: bahussuto appassutaṃ, yo sutena-atimaññati, andho padīpadhāro'va, tath'eva paṭibhāti maṃ.
mosavajje na nīyetha, sampajāno saṭhāni na kayirā, atha jīvitena paññāya, sīlabbatena n'āññam'atimaññe.
nikkhantaṃ arati c'eva, pesalā atimaññanā, ānandena subhāsitā, sāriputtapavāraṇā, parosahassaṃ koṇḍañño, moggallānena gaggarā, vaṅg'īsena dvādasā'ti.

yo me, mahārāja, dhanaṃ deti khattiyo vā brāhmaṇo vā vesso vā suddo vā añño vā koci, tesaṃ samakaṃ y'eva upaṭṭhahāmi, khattiyo'ti viseso n'atthi, suddo'ti atimaññanā n'atthi, anunayappaṭighavippamuttā dhanassāmikaṃ paricarāmi, esā me deva saccakiriyā, yāy'āhaṃ imaṃ mahāgaṅgaṃ paṭisotaṃ sandāpesin'ti.

examples.text: tatr'idaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā khattiyassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti dhanukalāpaṃ, dhanukalāpañ'ca pana khattiyo sandhanaṃ atimaññamāno akiccakārī hoti gopo'va adinnaṃ ādiyamāno'ti. idaṃ kho, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā khattiyassa sandhanaṃ paññapenti.

oren'addhamāso seso gimhānan'ti atirek'addhamāse sese gimhāne katvā nivāseti, nissaggiyaṃ hoti.

2299.meaning1: more than two or three bowlfuls; in excess of two or three full bowls

examples.text: atirekadvattipattapūre vematiko paṭiggaṇhāti, āpatti pācittiyassa. atirekadvattipattapūre ūnakasaññī paṭiggaṇhāti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
